title: Math or Death (Snapshot 25w21a)
description:
Solve a math problem every 10 minutes or die.
Does not work in newer Snapshots!
body:
## 📖 Description

In this datapack you will have to solve a math problem every 10 minutes. If you fail, you die. If you get it right, you dont :)
It also adds a timer for the playtime in the world.
